Version 1.0.14 makes Organizer failures and warnings self-explanatory in the Summary.

- A new Details section shows the affected input and complete reason instead of only `Errors: 1`.
- Existing-output stops include the full path and overwrite guidance.
- MKVToolNix diagnostics retain structural errors, resynchronization messages, and timestamps when available.
- Truncated file-table cells expose their complete content in tooltips.
